messages.text:
The reference’s stdout is mostly the final result and elapsed time, while progress-bar status is suppressed in this non-interactive run.

The next necessary state is a Python CLI that parses Clap-like options, validates files/ranges/masks, then searches candidate streams using Python ZIP decryption or AES verifier metadata when present.

commands.commandLine: {"command":"$files=@('rust-reference/src/main.rs','rust-reference/src/finder_errors.rs','rust-reference/src/password_worker.rs','rust-reference/src/password_mask.rs','rust-reference/src/args.rs'); foreach($f in $files){ Write-Output \"--- $f ---\"; $i=0; Get-Content $f | ForEach-Object { $i++; if(($f -like '*password_mask.rs' -and $i -le 240) -or ($f -like '*password_worker.rs') -or ($f -like '*args.rs' -and $i -ge 130) -or ($f -notlike '*password_mask.rs' -and $f -notlike '*password_worker.rs' -and $f -notlike '*args.rs')){ '{0}: {1}' -f $i,$_ } } }","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura_workspace\\target\\project-rebuild-source-port\\r-579eafcf27\\zip-password-finder\\tura-direct-1\\workspace","timeout_ms":15000}

{"command":"$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); & $ref -i rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip -p rust-reference/test-files/generated-passwords-lowercase.txt -w 1; Write-Output '---START---'; & $ref -i rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip -c l --minPasswordLen 1 --maxPasswordLen 2 -s ab -w 1; Write-Output '---SHORTHELP---'; & $ref -h; Write-Output '---TYPEERR---'; & $ref -i rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip -w abc","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura_workspace\\target\\project-rebuild-source-port\\r-579eafcf27\\zip-password-finder\\tura-direct-1\\workspace","timeout_ms":60000}
